summary: This topic explains how to assign subjects and their corresponding teachers to specific lecture slots within a created timetable schedule for each day of the week. It also covers defining breaks and handling multiple subjects in the same slot.
steps: Navigate to the created timetable for the desired class.
For each day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday, etc.) and for each lecture slot:
Select the 'Subject' from the dropdown list.
Select the 'Employee' (teacher) who is mapped for that subject.
Click 'Push' to assign the subject and teacher to the slot.
To define a break for a specific slot, toggle the 'Break' option.
To assign another subject or teacher for the same time slot (e.g., for different sections or parallel activities), use the 'another' option.
business_rules: Teachers must be mapped to subjects in the 'Teacher Assignment' section before they can be assigned in the timetable.
important_notes: The system allows for assigning multiple subjects or teachers to the same time slot, which can be useful for managing parallel activities or different sections.
